label: Symbolic Meaning
summary: Light symbolizes revelation, life, truth, and divine order.
body: Throughout Scripture light consistently represents revelation, life, divine presence, and the ordering of creation.

label: Literal Meaning
summary: Beginning identifies the first point in time or sequence.
body: Genesis introduces beginning as the start of creation and history.

label: Definition
summary: Creation is the act of bringing existence into being.
body: Creation refers to God's act of bringing the heavens, earth, and all living things into existence.
